title: The Friar's Notebook
subtitle: Twenty Sketches by Brother Luca
designed_property: Pacioli dodecahedron, 3D unit-ball graph (each page = one vertex; 3 edge-motifs per page, one per incident dodecahedral edge)

design_v2.principle: One motif per dodecahedron edge, not per page. 30 motifs total; each page carries exactly 3 motifs (one per incident edge). Adjacent pages share exactly 1 motif; non-adjacent pages share 0.
